title: RapidMeta Cardiology | Empagliflozin in Heart Failure (EMPEROR-Reduced + EMPEROR-Preserved) v1.0
hero_h2: Empagliflozin in Heart Failure Across the Ejection Fraction Spectrum

pico.pop: Adults with chronic heart failure across the ejection fraction spectrum (HFrEF LVEF <=40% in EMPEROR-Reduced; LVEF >40% in EMPEROR-Preserved), NYHA class II-IV with elevated NT-proBNP, on guideline-directed medical therapy
pico.int: Empagliflozin 10 mg orally once daily added to standard heart failure therapy
pico.comp: Placebo added to guideline-directed medical therapy
pico.out: Composite of adjudicated cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure (hazard ratio vs placebo)
pico.subgroup: Ejection fraction stratum (HFrEF vs HFpEF), type 2 diabetes status, baseline eGFR, NYHA class, age, sex

real_data_entries.name: EMPEROR-Reduced
real_data_entries.group: Empagliflozin 10 mg vs placebo in HFrEF (LVEF <=40%), NYHA II-IV; primary CV death or hospitalisation for heart failure (Packer NEJM 2020)

allOutcomes.title: Cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure (primary composite)

real_data_entries.robSource: Packer 2020 NEJM: randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, independent blinded event adjudication
real_data_entries.snippet: EMPEROR-Reduced NCT03057977: Packer M et al. NEJM 2020;383:1413-1424. 3,730 HFrEF patients (LVEF <=40%), empagliflozin 10mg (n=1863) vs placebo (n=1867). Primary CV death or HHF: 361 vs 462 (HR 0.75 [0.65-0.86], p<0.001). Arm sizes AACT-verified.

evidence.label: Enrollment & Design
evidence.text: 3,730 patients with HFrEF (LVEF <=40%), NYHA II-IV, elevated NT-proBNP randomised 1:1. Empagliflozin 10mg QD (n=1863) vs placebo (n=1867). Median follow-up 16 months.

evidence.label: Primary: CV death or HHF
evidence.text: Cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure: 361/1863 empagliflozin vs 462/1867 placebo. HR 0.75 (95% CI 0.65-0.86), p<0.001.

real_data_entries.name: EMPEROR-Preserved
real_data_entries.group: Empagliflozin 10 mg vs placebo in HF with LVEF >40% (HFpEF/HFmrEF), NYHA II-IV; primary CV death or hospitalisation for heart failure (Anker NEJM 2021)

allOutcomes.title: Cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure (primary composite)

real_data_entries.robSource: Anker 2021 NEJM: randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, independent blinded event adjudication
real_data_entries.snippet: EMPEROR-Preserved NCT03057951: Anker SD et al. NEJM 2021;385:1451-1461. 5,988 HF patients with LVEF >40%, empagliflozin 10mg (n=2997) vs placebo (n=2991). Primary CV death or HHF: 415 vs 511 (HR 0.79 [0.69-0.90], p<0.001). Values AACT-verified.

evidence.label: Enrollment & Design
evidence.text: 5,988 patients with HF and LVEF >40%, NYHA II-IV, elevated NT-proBNP randomised 1:1. Empagliflozin 10mg QD (n=2997) vs placebo (n=2991). Median follow-up 26 months.

evidence.label: Primary: CV death or HHF
evidence.text: Cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure: 415/2997 empagliflozin vs 511/2991 placebo. HR 0.79 (95% CI 0.69-0.90), p<0.001.
